note: Lyon County KY (FIPS 21143): no public queryable parcel service found after searching. gis.lyon-county.org Landbase/Parcels is Lyon County, Nevada (Fernley, Wellington, Mason Valley records), not Kentucky. The county GIS page requires a GIS Data Request Form and Open Records Request for parcel data. Kentucky's kygisserver hosts PVA parcel services for Webster and other counties but none for Lyon; the KGS list of PVA services omits Lyon. Parcels are only viewable through the Schneider Beacon/qPublic viewer (no public REST endpoint; returns 403 to automated access) and commercial vendors.
